  <title id="title">Evergreen Brews Logo</title>
  <desc id="desc">A minimalist logo where a single continuous line forms an evergreen tree transitioning into a coffee cup. Colors: Deep Forest Green and Warm Cream.</desc>
  
  <!-- Color Palette Definitions -->
  <defs>
    <style>
      .bg { fill: #FDFBF7; }          /* Warm Cream / Off-White */
      .fg { fill: #1B4D3E; }          /* Deep Forest Green */

    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background Circle (Optional container for app icons) -->
  <circle class="bg" cx="50" cy="50" r="48"/>

  <!-- Main Symbol: Single Path Construction -->
  <!-- 
       Path Logic:
       1. Start bottom-left (cup base)
       2. Up left side (cup body -> tree trunk)
       3. Zig-zag out for pine branches (foliage)
       4. Down right side (tree trunk -> cup body)
       5. Loop for cup handle
       6. Close at start
  -->
  <path class="fg" d="
    M 30,75 
    <!-- Cup Base / Tree Root -->
    L 30,70 
    <!-- Left Side Up (Cup Body -> Trunk) -->
    L 35,40 
    <!-- Foliage Zig-Zag (Left Side) -->
    L 20,45 L 38,38 L 18,30 L 36,25 L 22,20 
    <!-- Tree Apex -->
    L 50,10 
    <!-- Foliage Zig-Zag (Right Side) -->
    L 28,20 L 44,25 L 26,30 L 42,38 L 20,45

    L 65,40

    L 65,75 
    <!-- Base Line -->
    L 30,75 
    Z

    M 68,55 
    Q 78,55 78,45 
    Q 78,35 68,35 
    Q 62,35 62,45 
    Q 62,55 68,55 
    Z

    <text class="text" font-size="6.5" y="10">BREWS</text>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <style>
      @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;700&display=swap');
      
      /* Color Palette - Strict 2-Color Limit */
      .bg-cream { fill: #F6F4EE; }
      .fill-green { fill: #1C4A35; }
      .fill-cream { fill: #F6F4EE; }
      
      .stroke-green { 
        stroke: #1C4A35; 
        fill: none; 
        stroke-linecap: round; 
        stroke-linejoin: round; 
      }
      .stroke-cream { 
        stroke: #F6F4EE; 
        fill: none; 
        stroke-linecap: round; 
        stroke-linejoin: round; 
      }

      /* Typography */
      .brand-title {
        font-family: 'Montserrat', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 38px;
        fill: #1C4A35;
        letter-spacing: 8px;
        text-anchor: middle;
      }
      .brand-subtitle {
        font-family: 'Montserrat', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
        font-weight: 400;
        font-size: 16px;
        fill: #1C4A35;
        letter-spacing: 16px;
        text-anchor: middle;
      }
    </style>

    <!-- Mask to create clean negative space for the evergreen tree -->
    <mask id="mug-mask">
      <!-- White reveals, black conceals -->
      <rect width="800" height="600" fill="white" />
      <!-- The Evergreen Tree (Cutout) -->
      <path d="M 400 135 
               L 355 200 L 380 200 
               L 340 255 L 370 255 
               L 325 315 L 475 315 
               L 430 255 L 460 255 
               L 420 200 L 445 200 Z" fill="black" stroke="black" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </mask>
  </defs>

  <!-- 1. Background (Color 1: Warm Sustainable Cream) -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" class="bg-cream" />

  <!-- 2. Logo Mark (Color 2: Deep Evergreen) -->
  <g transform="translate(0, 15)">
    
    <!-- Minimalist Rising Sun / Warmth -->
    <path d="M 330 160 A 75 75 0 0 1 470 160" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="8" />

    <!-- Mug Handle -->
    <path d="M 480 200 H 505 A 30 30 0 0 1 535 230 V 250 A 30 30 0 0 1 505 280 H 480" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="14" />

    <!-- Mug Base & Masked Tree -->
    <!-- The mask punches the tree shape directly out of the solid mug body -->
    <path d="M 310 170 H 490 V 265 A 90 90 0 0 1 400 355 A 90 90 0 0 1 310 265 Z" class="fill-green" mask="url(#mug-mask)" />

    <!-- Coffee Bean / Tree Trunk Base (Negative Space) -->
    <g transform="translate(400, 320)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="13" ry="19" class="fill-cream" />
      <!-- Coffee Bean Center Cut -->
      <path d="M 0 -19 C -6 -6, 6 6, 0 19" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="3.5" />
    </g>

    <!-- Minimalist Saucer / Ground Line -->
    <line x1="340" y1="382" x2="460" y2="382" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="8" />
    
  </g>

  <!-- 3. Typography -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 475)">
    <!-- X-offset slightly applied to compensate for optical illusion of wide letter-spacing -->
    <text x="4" y="0" class="brand-title">EVERGREEN</text>
    
    <!-- Subtitle with Decorative Flanking Lines -->
    <g transform="translate(0, 40)">
      <text x="8" y="0" class="brand-subtitle">BREWS</text>
      <!-- Left Line -->
      <line x1="-145" y1="-6" x2="-95" y2="-6" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="2" />
      <!-- Right Line -->
      <line x1="95" y1="-6" x2="145" y2="-6" class="stroke-green" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>
